title: Check: observability
description: Five questions on seeing what the cluster is doing.

questions.prompt: Write the command that shows CPU and memory usage per node.
questions.explanation: It needs metrics-server; without it the command reports that metrics are not available.

options.text: Recent resource usage for `kubectl top` and the HPA

questions.explanation: It is deliberately not a monitoring system: no history, no alerting. Prometheus fills that role.

questions.prompt: How long do Events last by default?
questions.explanation: Which is why a post-mortem needs them shipped somewhere. `--event-ttl` on the API server changes it.

questions.prompt: Where do container logs live on a node?

options.text: On the node's filesystem, written by the container runtime

questions.explanation: `kubectl logs` reads them through the kubelet. Delete the Pod and they are gone - hence log aggregation.

questions.prompt: Write the command that shows the logs of the previous, crashed instance of container app in Pod web.
questions.explanation: The single most useful flag for a CrashLoopBackOff, because the current container may have no logs yet.
